theme_label_cn: 冰雪蓝主题 · 纸伞 · 寒山灵境·守雪人（新角色示范，未实跑验收）
age_phrase: a slender young woman of about twenty-one
watermark: plum blossoms, snowflakes and folded pine
gradient: pale frost blue at the top to a deeper slate blue lower down
moon_halo: a hazy full moon ringed by a pale silver halo
backdrop: silhouetted mountain ridges and a small tiered Chinese pavilion standing behind the figure
hair_ornaments: small plum blossoms and silver snowflake pins
robe_gradient: pale frost blue at the chest to saturated slate blue at the trailing hem
hold_action: {V:hold} a pale blue jade parasol "雪落" raised before {o}
weapon_charm: a silver snowflake charm hanging from its handle
expr_desc_1: {p} eyelids sit cool and half lowered with the pupils showing beneath them, and the corners of {p} mouth curve up into a soft cool smile
expr_desc_2: {p} head is upright but {p} lids are lowered until {p} gaze rests down and away and {p} eyes are barely open, {p} lips closed and relaxed
expr_desc_3: {p} head tips a little back, {p} lids sit low and glossy, {p} lips part loosely and colour rises on both cheeks
expr_desc_4: {p} head turns three-quarters away from the reader and {p} chin lifts, while {p} eyes turn back toward the reader over {p} shoulder
profile: 性格：清冷自持，外冷内热
喜好：煮雪烹茶、收留迷途、雪中独行
couplet: 我本无心，只因你入梦，便留了心。
weapon_drawing: a small drawing of the pale blue jade parasol
background_text: 素雪，寒山灵境的守雪人。{T}以伞引鹤，以雪为舟，渡人归寒，却从不入他人的炉火。看似清冷自持、游戏人间，实则温热孤勇，只肯在雪夜独行。{T}在灵境中种满寒梅，引万千白鹤为伴，唯独等一个从不回头的旅人。伞声起时，白雪覆山；伞声落处，雪落无痕。
signature: —— 一伞一鹤一浮生，梦里不知身是客。
lighting: the pale winter moon behind thin cloud
palette: moon white, frost blue and ice blue
